  • Constructor Details

    • ClaimActionPermissionOverride

      public ClaimActionPermissionOverride(@Nonnull ClaimActionPermissionOverrideType type, @Nullable net.minecraft.network.chat.Component reason)
      Constructs a claim action permission override instance with a specified type and reason.

      At the moment, the reason for the override is only ever displayed when forbidding a claiming action. But feel free to provide a reason for a non-forbidding override. It might be used in the future.

      All override types can be seen at ClaimActionPermissionOverrideType.

      Parameters:
      type - the type of the override, not null
      reason - the reason for the override, can be null
